Kenney UI Pack
===============

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/ui-pack

License: CC0. See License.txt in this folder.

Usage in this project:
- Full downloaded PNG, Sounds, Font folders are archived here.
- Runtime UI files are also copied under Assets/Resources/VRTrainingUI/Kenney so
  CPR runtime-generated UI can load sprites and click sounds in Quest builds.

Notes:
- Kenney Future fonts are kept for optional Latin/numeric labels.
- They are not applied as the default Chinese/Japanese UI font.
